This is a low-confidence guess. `SourceInfo` is the MetaModelica record that stores source-location information. The Parser module holds C headers for the MetaModelica/Julia layer, which builds such records, so the file plausibly sits there. It could instead be one of the runtime C files under the Compiler or SimulationRuntime trees.
